interventions: Stopped legacy BGE service; active workspace GTE binding retained.
Drained workers and restarted API, then checked synthetic GTE vectors and runtime hashes.
One-time sync and clean Linux page/slab cache reclaim; no persistent WSL policy change.
Kept administrator API, OCR service and other user applications running.
additional_savings_candidates: Administrator API on demand: about 867 MiB measured PSS; not applied, user preference pending because admin CLI/API availability changes.
Lazy loading optional TaskHandler/common.settings dependencies: code paths inspected, savings not measured, no implementation changes.
limits: One measured run; excludes service restart, cache reclaim, discovery and reset preparation. Not a long-duration stability certification.
The 2 GiB free Windows RAM preflight target was not reached. Peak RAM remained 99 percent; memory pressure is unresolved.
API processing reloaded memory after restart; immediate restart savings are not steady-state savings.
Several environmental interventions and uncontrolled host activity prevent attributing the speed gain to one cause.
Docker displayed memory and cgroup memory.current account for cache differently; compare matching metrics.
GPU and host CPU/RAM metrics are system-wide. Preview and watcher were paused during measurement.
Cache clearing may add CPU and I/O overhead; it was not installed as recurring maintenance.
BGE was stopped, not deleted; base Compose may start it again. No product code or .wslconfig changed.
